band_rule: flag when the endpoint's statistic exceeds high; high is the 95th percentile of the statistic over five honest serving variants of the same weights (default kernels, max 8 sequences, prefix cache off, CUDA graphs off, fp16), 20 repeats each

bands.metric: CvM statistic, one endpoint answer per prompt over 100 prompts

prompt_set: development set, public in reference/gpu/prompts; production prompts are sealed
test: T2 RUT: Cramer-von Mises statistic of log-rank ranks, Zhu et al. arXiv 2506.06975
